title: Forge Hub | Full Task Autofarm, Auto Age, Webhook Tracking+
features:
FEATURES:

AUTO FARM

- Auto Complete Needs (works on pet and your own baby needs)

- Auto Choose Mystery Needs

- Live Tracker

- Auto Equip Pets (youngest or oldest, filter by species)

- Auto Age Pets (target age)

- Auto Claim Dropped Rewards

- Pet Scanner

ECONOMY

- Idle Pen Farm (filter by species, custom interval)

- Auto Claim Daily Rewards

- Claim Star Rewards

- Auto Use Bonus Potions (bucks and aging)

- Code Redeemer

- Claim Achievement Rewards

- Open All Gifts

- Money Tree Collector

- Auto Paycheck

PLAYER

- Walk Speed (adjustable)

- Jump Power (adjustable)

- Infinite Jump

- Fly (adjustable speed, hotkey)

- No Clip

- Save and Return Position

- Rejoin Server

- Building Teleports

- Landmark Teleports

- Teleport to Players (and follow)

VISUALS

- Player ESP (boxes, names, distance, tracers, highlight, pet info, custom range)

- ESP Style (custom colors)

- Fullbright

- No Fog

- Time of Day Changer

- Field of View (adjustable)

- FPS Booster

- Black Screen

- FPS Cap (adjustable)

WEBHOOKS

- Discord Logging (main and backup endpoints)

- Event Filters (choose what gets logged)

- Session Summaries (custom interval up to 12h)

- Custom Embeds (color, name, role ping)

- Live Farm Updates (custom interval)

- Connection Test

MISC

- Anti AFK

- Live Stats Watermark (always on screen)

- Mobile Supported
